mapper.sql: primary_key , "state", enterprise_code, inspection_item::BIGINT[], product_part_type, enter_time, "name", pcs, creator, version, sync_status, "attribute", update_count, files::BIGINT[], default_route, contact_person, model, whether_test, "standard", actual_check_items::BIGINT[], product_part_sign, create_time, update_time, delete_flag, remark
mapper.select:
SELECT a.primary_key, a."state", a.enterprise_code,
a.product_part_sign, a.product_part_type,
a.enter_time, a.pcs, a.creator, a.version, a.sync_status, a."attribute", a.update_count,
a.contact_person, a.model, a.whether_test, a."standard",
a.create_time, a.update_time, a.delete_flag, a.remark, b.procedure_code, b.quantity, b.process_route_data_code FROM ${productPartTableName} a, ${productPartRouteRelationshipTableName} b WHERE enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} AND delete_flag = 'f' and a.primary_key = b.product_part_code and b.process_route_data_code = #{processRoute}

SELECT a.primary_key, a."state", a.enterprise_code,
a.product_part_sign, a.product_part_type,
a.enter_time, a.pcs, a.creator, a.version, a.sync_status, a."attribute", a.update_count,
a.contact_person, a.model, a.whether_test, a."standard",
a.create_time, a.update_time, a.delete_flag, a.remark, b.procedure_code, b.quantity, b.process_route_data_code ,b.unique_id FROM ${productPartTableName} a, ${procedurePartRelationshipTableName} b WHERE a.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} AND a.delete_flag = 'f' and b.delete_flag = 'f' and b.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and a.primary_key =b.product_part_code and ( b.unique_id ,b.procedure_code ) in
(#{item.uniqueId},#{item.productPartProcedureCode})

SELECT a.primary_key, a."state", a.enterprise_code,
a.product_part_sign, a.product_part_type,
a.enter_time, a.pcs, a.creator, a.version, a.sync_status, a."attribute", a.update_count,
a.contact_person, a.model, a.whether_test, a."standard",
a.create_time, a.update_time, a.delete_flag, a.remark, b.procedure_code, b.quantity, b.process_route_data_code FROM ${productPartTableName} a, ${procedurePartRelationshipTableName} b WHERE a.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} AND a.delete_flag = 'f' and b.delete_flag = 'f' and b.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and a.primary_key =b.product_part_code and b.process_route_data_code in
#{item}
and a.primary_key =#{partCode}

select distinct lxTogx.procedure_code gx , lxTogx.process_route_data_code lx , gxTolj.product_part_code lj , gxTolj.quantity , gx.product_part_procedure_sign gx_name from ${procedureRouteRelationship} lxTogx left join ${procedurePartRelationship} gxTolj on lxTogx.unique_id = gxTolj.unique_id and lxTogx.procedure_code = gxTolj.procedure_code left join ${productPartProcedure} gx on lxTogx.procedure_code = gx.primary_key where lxTogx.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and lxTogx.product_part_code = #{id}

select distinct * from ( select a.procedure_code, c.unique_id, c.process_route_data_code route_code, c.product_part_code product_code, a.product_part_code part_code ,a.quantity, e.product_part_procedure_sign procedure_name,e.nature procedure_nature, d.pcs part_pcs,d.model part_model,d.product_part_sign part_name,d.product_part_type part_type, f.pcs product_pcs,f.model product_model,f.product_part_sign product_name,f.product_part_type product_type, f.default_route product_Switch_route , f.remark product_remark ,d.remark part_remark ,e.remark procedure_remark
,g.state route_state ,g.procedure_data route_Bind_Procedure_Codes_base
from ${productPartRouteRelationshipTableName} c join ${partTableName} f on c.product_part_code = f.primary_key and f.delete_flag = 'f' and f.state=true
left join ${procedurePartRelationshipTableName} a on c.unique_id = a.unique_id
AND a.delete_flag = 'f'
and exists ( select 1 from ${partTableName} aa where a.product_part_code=aa.primary_key
and aa.attribute in
#{item}
and aa.delete_flag = 'f')
left join ${partTableName} d on a.product_part_code = d.primary_key AND d.delete_flag = 'f' and d.state=true left join ${procedureTableName} e on a.procedure_code = e.primary_key AND e.delete_flag = 'f'
left join ${routeTableName} g on g.primary_key=c.process_route_data_code and g.delete_flag = 'f'
where c.product_part_code = #{productId}
and c.process_route_data_code = #{processRoute}
and c.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and c.product_part_code = f.primary_key and f.delete_flag = 'f' and c.delete_flag = 'f' and c.state=true
) as a

SELECT id, state, enterprise_code, product_part_type, enter_time, pcs, remark, creator, version, sync_status, attribute, quality_code_list::BIGINT[], warehouse_person, update_count, files::BIGINT[], default_route, contact_person, model, whether_test, standard, product_part_sign, dynamic_sort, primary_key productPartCode, create_time, update_time, delete_flag FROM ${productPartTableName} WHERE enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} AND delete_flag = 'f' and primary_key = #{productPartCode}

SELECT product_part_type as productPartTypeCode, attribute, standard, product_part_sign as productPartSign, model as model, primary_key as productPartCode, unity_no as unityNo, delete_flag as deleteFlag FROM ${productPartTableName} AS p WHERE p.product_part_type = #{productPartType} AND p.delete_flag = false AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ${outboundOrderDetail} AS o WHERE o.product_or_part = p.primary_key AND o.delete_flag = false)

SELECT product_part_type as productPartTypeCode, attribute, standard, product_part_sign as productPartSign, model as model, primary_key as productPartCode, unity_no as unityNo, delete_flag as deleteFlag FROM ${productPartTableName} AS p WHERE p.product_part_type = #{productPartType} AND p.delete_flag = false AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ${outboundOrderDetail} AS o WHERE o.product_or_part = p.primary_key AND o.delete_flag = false)

SELECT a.id, primary_key product_Part_Code, state, enterprise_code, quality_code_list::BIGINT[], a.product_part_type product_Part_Type_Code, enter_time, product_part_sign, pcs, creator, version, sync_status, attribute, update_count, files::BIGINT[], default_route, contact_person, model, whether_test, standard, create_time, update_time, delete_Flag, remark, warehouse_person, unity_no, extra FROM ${dynamicTableNameProxy.productPart} a WHERE primary_key = #{id}
